misses.reply: Men texten redovisar bara en intern försöksanteckning från Elm Quay, och den säger uttryckligen att skillnaden i mediantid inte beror på programvaran.
misses.judge_says: The text says only that the note "tillskriver … inte skillnaden programvaran" (does not attribute the difference to the software). That is a refusal to attribute, not a denial of cause, so the finding raises the certainty of a qualified statement.
misses.check: input.md line 19: "Perioderna hade olika arbetsbelastning, och anteckningen tillskriver därför inte skillnaden programvaran." The note withholds attribution because the periods differed; it nowhere says, explicitly or otherwise, that the difference does not come from the software. The text contradicts "säger uttryckligen".

misses.reply: Det är nu Maya Lind som berättar vad försöket krävde, inte anteckningar.
misses.judge_says: Finding 4 also says what the trial required "kommer från den berättande texten och från Maya Linds citat". The rewrite then gives the whole of it to Lind, and that attribution change is not reported.
misses.check: The returned intro says "Vad det krävde berättar arbetsledaren Maya Lind om", yet part of what the trial required (Svale configured the log, six staff trained) is stated by the narrator, not by Lind. The entry reports the move from the notes to Lind but not that narrator-stated facts are now credited to her; the judge is right that attribution moved further than the entry says.

misses.reply: Rubriken – ”Elm Quay samlade reparationsärendena” var för generell. Bestämd form utan avgränsning lät som att Elm Quay hade samlat alla sina reparationsärenden. [...] (and the opening: "Jag hittade fyra fel i texten")
misses.judge_says: The input headline has no visible defect, so this is a change of taste that also changes scope. [...] The reply's opening, "Jag hittade fyra fel i texten", presents four defects in a text the reply itself says "följer artikelanatomin utan avvikelse".
misses.check: The input headline is in the bare definite form and does not itself say the trial was bounded; the finding's description is true. The judge disputes only whether it (and the four findings as a set) were real defects. The new length claim checks out: 45 characters, 6 words.

misses.reply: Inledningen, andra meningen – ”Försöket” i bestämd form syftade bara tillbaka på ingressen.
misses.judge_says: Class: a change of taste. The definite form points back to the standfirst, which is ordinary in an article. The claim is unchanged.
misses.check: In input.md the intro's "Försöket" has no antecedent in the body before it, only in the standfirst; the finding is true, and the judge disputes only whether that is a defect.

misses.reply: den säger uttryckligen att skillnaden i mediantid inte beror på programvaran.
misses.judge_says: The finding's rationale misstates the source [...] the note declines to attribute the difference and does not deny a software effect. The finding therefore turns a withheld attribution into a denial.
misses.check: Same sentence, input.md line 19: the note "tillskriver därför inte skillnaden programvaran"; it does not state that the difference is not caused by the software. Contradicted.

misses.reply: Det är nu Maya Lind som berättar vad försöket krävde, inte anteckningar.
misses.judge_says: The reply also says the requirements come "från den berättande texten och från Maya Linds citat", yet its fix credits them to Lind alone. [...] The new attribution is slightly inaccurate. Part of what the trial required is stated by the narrator, not by Lind: Svale configured the log and trained six staff.
misses.check: As for judge a: the narrator's statements about Svale's configuration and the training now read as something Lind tells, which the entry does not say. Attribution moved; the entry is short.

misses.reply: Rubriken – ”Elm Quay samlade reparationsärendena” var för generell. [...] Den som bara såg rubriken fick inte veta att det var ett avgränsat försök.
misses.judge_says: The case for calling it a visible defect is weak, because the standfirst straight below already limits the trial to two buildings and eight weeks. Mostly a change of taste.
misses.check: The headline alone does not say the trial was bounded, so the finding's statement about a reader who sees only the headline is true; the judge disputes whether it is a real defect, given the standfirst bounds it.

misses.reply: Inledningen, andra meningen – ”Försöket” i bestämd form syftade bara tillbaka på ingressen.
misses.judge_says: Class: a change of taste, or at most a marginal referent repair. The meaning is unchanged. [...] Finding 3 is taste too.
misses.check: True of the input; the judge disputes only whether it is a defect.

notes: Both judges remark that the reply does not mention the standfirst growing from 40 to 44 words (counted: 44), and judge b that the headline grew from 36 to 45 characters, but both call those entries accurate and the reply states the headline's new length; not recorded as misses. Judge a says outright that it does not count the length change on its own.
